summary: Iteration 3 (CSV/PDF export + admin alerts + modal refactor) — ALL TESTS PASSING. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (test_alerts_export.py 10 + test_checklist.py 4). New endpoints verified: GET /api/admin/checklist-alerts (admin-only, staff gets 403; flags 'Below target' and 'No submission today' templates with overall_percent + target_percent), GET /api/forms/templates/{id}/stats/export?format=csv (text/csv with Template/Range/Submissions/Target/Overall headers + Item,Sub-task,Done,Missed,Submissions table), ?format=pdf (application/pdf, valid %PDF magic bytes, >500 bytes), date_from/date_to filter works (zero-subs window returns 'Submissions: 0'), invalid format → 400, unknown tpl → 404, no auth → 401/403. Regression: /stats schema unchanged (overall_done/overall_possible/overall_percent/on_target/items/submissions/target_percent), regular form kind create+submit still works. Frontend (mobile 375x812): Admin login → Home shows red 'admin-alerts' card with 5 alert rows (alert-{id}) including 'Below target 50%/100%' and 'No submission today 0%/100%'. Staff login → admin-alerts card NOT rendered (correct). Admin Panel → Forms → 'Create Form/Checklist' opens FormBuilderModal with kind-form/kind-checklist chips, switching to checklist reveals checklist-target + checklist-bulk inputs. Stats button on a template opens StatsModal with range-day/week/month/all + export-csv + export-pdf testIDs all visible; per-item card shows HL29 100%, HL30 50%, HL31 0%; Export CSV click triggers web blob download without errors. Refactor: admin.tsx reduced 735 → 298 lines; modals extracted to /app/frontend/src/components/FormBuilderModal.tsx (299 lines) and StatsModal.tsx (273 lines). No red-screen errors, only 1 benign 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' warning.
action_items: Optional: support a download with file save on web (currently uses anchor click which works fine in Chromium; verify on Safari).
Optional: replace deprecated `props.pointerEvents` with `style.pointerEvents` somewhere in component tree to silence React Native Web warning.
critical_code_review_comments: checklist-alerts endpoint is admin-gated via require_admin (verified 403 for staff).
Export endpoint correctly streams CSV via StreamingResponse with text/csv and PDF via reportlab with application/pdf; Content-Disposition attachment header set.

StatsModal.exportFile uses Platform.OS branch — web uses fetch+blob+anchor download; native uses FileSystem.downloadAsync + Sharing.shareAsync. Token retrieved via getToken() and passed as Authorization header — correct.
FormBuilderModal owns its own state and resets on publish — clean separation. admin.tsx is now ~298 lines, well under the 700 split threshold.
